verdict.T153: The source explicitly labels a candidate proof conditional on 210 obligations, including 15 mathematical premises; cheap check.py does not recompute capture rows or tree certificates.
verdict.T154: The final theorem has only L as a parameter and states all independently translated/rotated closed unit squares with pairwise disjoint interiors. The assembly discharges the formerly explicit census, classification, ordinary, neighbour, and capture premises. No hidden global exclusion premise or finite-index gap was found in the interfaces reviewed.
verdict.confidence_limit: This is not a complete proof audit and not independent proof replay. Most generated certificates and several geometric checker-soundness internals were not read; 3738 source modules were not downloaded.
verdict.trust_boundary: Standard Lean axioms propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound plus Lean compiler, native evaluator, and C toolchain for 13343 native_decide facts. This is explicitly not kernel-only finite evaluation.
verdict.version: T154 pins Lean/Mathlib 4.34.1. The local dlw runtime is 4.34.0; directly reusing the whole package is not an already-passed build.

findings.finding: Unit directions satisfy ux^2+uy^2=1; independent existential centres/directions; Fin 17 square sets; only interiors disjoint. Final equivalence has no certificate premise.

346104 distinct valid 17-subsets of 24 cells equal choose(24,17); validity includes an actual D4 map to a representative. Strict tags establish uniqueness; finite-subset containment plus equal card proves complete coverage, not merely a matching count.
All k >= 2781 are proved to yield fullCases k = [], by bounding every tree key. Thus length=17 implies k<2781. It does not only test the single out-of-range index 2781.

Assigned cells are injective and occupied set has exactly 17 members. This proves all roster cells occur, then selects an injective owner reindexing. There is no assumed correspondence between arbitrary input labels and source witness labels.

The source deliberately proves that a bare excludes call with n=3 and a two-owner state returns true. Production roster/tree wrappers require state.length=n, and branch semantics uses state.length; this prevents the demonstrated misuse. Preserve this guard in any 37 implementation.

Left and right children both include the splitting boundary. CheckpointCover proves each parent owner-domain lies in child domain, with the selected owner additionally guarded. All owner counts are equal; accepted run preserves length.

CaptureTerminalOptimality has a stale docstring describing an externally replayed trace. Final imports instead use CaptureOpen.Optimality and CaptureWindowBridge: concrete native-checked trace/summary plus Lean propagation and preserved actual target-box containment supply the local chart. The old conditional skeleton is not the final theorem.

next_obligation: The indispensable missing theorem is that every arbitrary 37-square packing below the exact target enters a completely enumerated family, and every family is either impossible or captured by a proved local side obstruction. Local witness validation, local KKT algebra, and a conditional assembly theorem do not supply this global statement.
